issuer.name: Foothill College
issuer.description: A California community college in the Foothill-De Anza Community College District, offering associate degrees, certificates, and transfer pathways in the Silicon Valley region.

achievement.name: Associate in Arts (AA)
achievement.description: Completion of the Associate in Arts degree in Business Administration at Foothill College, including general education breadth and major coursework in accounting, finance, marketing, management, and economics.

criteria.narrative: Candidates must complete a minimum of 90 units including Foothill College general education requirements and the Business Administration major (45 units). A minimum cumulative GPA of 2.0 is required for graduation.
